description: This source file defines the VoiceSessionCoordinator class, which manages voice recognition sessions including starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing voice sessions. It interfaces with overlay controllers and forwarding mechanisms to coordinate voice wake and command handling.

classes.name: VoiceSessionCoordinator
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing voice recognition sessions, including starting, updating, finalizing, and dismissing sessions, as well as coordinating with UI overlays and forwarding mechanisms.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Initiates a new voice session with specified source, text, and optional attributed text. Returns a UUID token representing the session.

methods.name: updatePartial
methods.description: Updates the current session with partial recognized text and optional attributed text.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the session with final recognized text, a chime, and optional auto-send delay, then presents the final UI overlay.

methods.name: sendNow
methods.description: Forces immediate sending of the current session's text if not empty, dismissing the overlay afterwards.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the current session overlay with a specified reason and outcome.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the voice input level indicator for the current session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns the current session token, text, and visibility status of the overlay.

methods.name: overlayDidDismiss
methods.description: Callback invoked when overlay is dismissed, which clears the session and refreshes runtime state.
